# seerr_genres (Data Source)

Fetch TMDB genre reference lists for movies or TV shows to resolve names to numerical IDs.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `media_type` (String) Media type to fetch genres for (`movie` or `tv`). Defaults to `movie`.

### Read-Only

- `genres` (Attributes List) List of genres. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--genres))
- `id` (String) Data source identifier.
- `total` (Number) Total number of genres returned.

<a id="nestedatt--genres"></a>
### Nested Schema for `genres`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numerical TMDB genre ID.
- `name` (String) Genre name (e.g. Action, Comedy, Drama).
